exercise_name: Just Give Me A Reason · Listening & Vocabulary
description: 《Just Give Me a Reason》描寫一對戀人在感情出現裂痕後，努力尋找理解與重新相愛的可能。女方察覺彼此逐漸疏遠，開始懷疑對方是否已經失去愛意；男方卻認為感情依然存在，只是雙方缺乏溝通，令誤解與不安不斷累積。兩人雖然對問題有不同的看法，卻仍然珍惜曾經擁有的幸福，希望找到修補關係的方法。歌曲以「彎曲而未破碎」象徵受傷卻仍有希望的愛情。最終，《Just Give Me a Reason》傳達的是愛情中的信任、溝通與重新開始的勇氣：即使感情經歷挫折，只要雙方願意坦誠面對問題、理解彼此的感受，仍有機會修復傷痕，重新找回曾經的親密與幸福。

vocabulary.meaning: 從一開始就；強調事情開始的那一刻
vocabulary.usage: 用在故事、計畫或經驗的開頭，通常放在句首或句尾。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「right from the start」？
options: Right from the start, our new robot called the teacher “Grandma.”
We arrived right from the start the airport at noon.
The film was right from the start for three hours.
Please right from the start this computer before class.
optionExplanations: 正確：表示機器人一開始就叫老師「奶奶」，既自然又好笑。
錯誤：這個片語不能代替表示地點的 at；應說 arrived at the airport。
錯誤：不能用它表示一段時間的長度；應說 lasted three hours。
錯誤：這不是「啟動」的動詞；應說 start this computer。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示機器人一開始就叫老師「奶奶」，既自然又好笑。

vocabulary.meaning: 願意的；自願做某件事的
vocabulary.usage: 常用 be willing to + 原形動詞，表示願意做某事。
options: I am willing helping at the museum this weekend.
Our coach is willing to wear a pink cape if we win the final.
The train is willing at platform five.
She willing to teach me how to play chess.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：willing 後要接 to help，不能直接接 helping。
正確：be willing to wear 表示教練願意穿粉紅披風慶祝。
錯誤：willing 描述意願，不表示火車停靠的位置。
錯誤：willing 是形容詞，前面需要 is；應說 She is willing to teach me。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：be willing to wear 表示教練願意穿粉紅披風慶祝。

vocabulary.usage: 指睡著時不自覺說話；可依主詞改變 your / his / her。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「talk in your sleep」？
options: My uncle talks in his sleep every morning at breakfast.
I talked in my sleep because I sent an email at work.
My sister talks in her sleep and sometimes gives speeches about space.
The actors talked in their sleep on stage while they were fully awake.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：早餐時清醒地說話不叫說夢話。
錯誤：寄工作郵件是清醒行為，不能用來解釋說夢話。
正確：表示妹妹睡著時會說夢話，甚至談太空。
錯誤：既然演員完全清醒，就不是真正在說夢話。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示妹妹睡著時會說夢話，甚至談太空。

vocabulary.usage: 常用 have had enough of + 名詞／動名詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「have had enough」？
options: We have had enough of the broken lift, so we are taking the stairs.
I have had enough to the long meeting.
The photographer has had enough with waiting in the rain.
She has had enough the loud music from next door.
optionExplanations: 正確：表示大家受夠壞掉的電梯，決定走樓梯。
錯誤：這裡要用 of the long meeting，不是 to。
錯誤：標準搭配是 had enough of waiting，而非 with waiting。
錯誤：缺少介系詞 of；應說 enough of the loud music。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示大家受夠壞掉的電梯，決定走樓梯。

vocabulary.usage: 可描述金屬、形狀或物體；也可用於比喻，與 broken 不同。
options: The street was bent because the shops were closed.
The cyclist checked his wheel because it looked bent after the race.
My phone is bent because its battery is almost empty.
The singer felt bent when the crowd cheered loudly.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：商店關門不會讓街道變彎；這裡因果不合理。
正確：賽後車輪看起來彎了，bent 使用自然。
錯誤：電量低不代表手機形狀彎曲。
錯誤：歡呼讓人高興或興奮，不是形容身體／物品彎曲。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：賽後車輪看起來彎了，bent 使用自然。

vocabulary.usage: 可用於皮膚上的疤痕，也能比喻痛苦經驗留下的影響。
options: The weather report said there would be three scars tomorrow.
I bought a scar to travel from Paris to Rome.
The old cut left a small scar on his arm.
The musician turned up the scar so everyone could hear the song.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：天氣預報不會用 scar 表示降雨或暴風雨。
錯誤：scar 不是車票或交通工具；應說 ticket。
正確：傷口痊癒後在手臂留下小疤痕。
錯誤：scar 不是音量；應說 turned up the volume。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：傷口痊癒後在手臂留下小疤痕。

vocabulary.meaning: 只是你想像的；問題並非客觀存在（依語境）
vocabulary.usage: 常用於安慰或反駁猜測，但不應隨意否定他人真實的感受。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「all in your mind」？
options: You think the whole audience hates you, but that may be all in your mind.
The museum opens at nine; it is all in your mind on the website.
I left my wallet all in your mind on the train.
We put the science project all in your mind next to the window.
optionExplanations: 正確：表示觀眾討厭你的想法可能只是自己的猜測。
錯誤：網站上的開放時間是資訊，不是想像出來的。
錯誤：片語不是「留在某處」，也不能代替 on the train。
錯誤：它不表示物品的實際擺放位置。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示觀眾討厭你的想法可能只是自己的猜測。

vocabulary.meaning: （想像、情緒等）不受控制；自由奔馳
vocabulary.usage: 常用 imagination runs wild 或 fears run wild。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「run wild」？
options: The pilot ran wild the plane at six in the morning.
When the lights went out in the castle, the children's imaginations ran wild.
I ran wild my passport at the hotel desk.
The chef ran wild the soup for ten minutes.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：run wild 不能當作「駕駛飛機」的及物動詞。
正確：城堡突然停電，孩子們開始天馬行空地想像。
錯誤：這個片語不表示出示證件；應說 showed my passport。
錯誤：煮湯不能用 run wild；應說 cooked the soup。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：城堡突然停電，孩子們開始天馬行空地想像。

vocabulary.meaning: 積灰塵；因長期不用而閒置
vocabulary.usage: 常說 something is collecting dust，強調物品被放著不用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「collect dust」？
options: The swimmer collected dust by swimming faster than everyone else.
The airport collected dust because many planes arrived early.
I collect dust when I write secret notes to my friends.
My old guitar has been collecting dust since I started learning drums.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：游得快不等於積灰塵；這個片語不表示贏得比賽。
錯誤：航班提早抵達與物品閒置積塵沒有關係。
錯誤：寫紙條不是 collect dust 的意思；可說 write notes。
正確：舊吉他因為改學鼓而長期閒置、積灰塵。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：舊吉他因為改學鼓而長期閒置、積灰塵。

vocabulary.meaning: 坦白說出真相；承認原本隱瞞的事
vocabulary.usage: 通常是 come clean about + 事情，或 come clean with + 人。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「come clean」？
options: The engineer came clean the window before the inspection.
We came clean to the cinema at seven o’clock.
The mayor came clean of the city hall after lunch.
The class president finally came clean about losing the concert tickets.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：come clean 不是「擦乾淨」；應說 cleaned the window。
錯誤：come clean 不是「到達」；應說 arrived at the cinema。
錯誤：come clean 不表示從建築物走出來；應說 came out of。
正確：班長終於坦白弄丟演唱會門票。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：班長終於坦白弄丟演唱會門票。

audioAlignment.reviewStatus: Conservative automatic line alignment. Unmatched/overlapping background lines remain bilingual without guessed timestamps; not a full manual timing certification.

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 強調「從一開始」便如此。
questions.usage: 講事情從開始就有某種狀態。
questions.prompt: 展覽第一天就有許多人參觀。哪句最貼切？
options: Right from the start is a painting on the wall.
Right from the start, many people came to see the art.
Many people right from to see the art.
Right from the art, many people start came.
optionExplanations: 把時間片語誤當作一幅畫。
正確；right from the start 指從最初就如此。
片語位置及動詞結構不完整。
把 right from 後的起點誤換成不合句意的 art。
questions.cue: 「Right from the start」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：固定時間起點，不必硬拆為兩個題目。
questions.explanation: 正確；right from the start 指從最初就如此。

questions.meaning: stole 是 steal 的過去式，敘述已發生的事。
questions.usage: 談已完成的過去事件。
questions.prompt: 昨晚有人拿走展館的舊地圖。
options: Someone stolen the old map last night.
Someone steal the old map last night.
Someone stole the old map last night.
Someone stealing the old map last night.
optionExplanations: stolen 是過去分詞，不能單獨當述語。
last night 需用過去式 stole。
正確；stole 是過去式。
缺少助動詞，不能單用 stealing。
questions.cue: 「You stole my heart」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：原句以偷心作比喻，練習採中性敘事。
questions.explanation: 正確；stole 是過去式。

questions.word: 省略 be 的詩歌並列句
questions.meaning: 歌詞略去 was，留下主詞與名詞補語。
questions.usage: 閱讀詩歌、歌曲時辨認省略，正式寫作要補足動詞。
questions.prompt: 哪句忠實描述原歌這個不完整句式？
options: The line includes every verb needed in standard English.
The word 'victim' is the main verb in the line.
The line uses have and a past participle.
optionExplanations: 歌詞缺少連繫動詞。
正確；語境承接前一句的過去時。
victim 在這裡是名詞。
歌詞沒有 have/has + 過去分詞。
questions.cue: 「And I your willing victim」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：此題測來源辨識；補上的 was 只是教師說明，並非原詞。
questions.explanation: 正確；語境承接前一句的過去時。

questions.meaning: let + 人 + 動詞原形，表示允許某人做事。
questions.usage: 給予別人觀看、嘗試或參與的機會。
questions.prompt: 攝影師同意朋友看看新照片。
options: The artist let see her friend the photos.
The artist let her friend see the photos.
The artist let her friend to see the photos.
The artist lets her friend seeing the photos.
optionExplanations: 受詞及 see 的順序不對。
正確；let + 人 + see。
let 後不加 to。
let 後用原形 see。
questions.cue: 「I let you see the parts of me」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁

pattern.text: you see the parts of me

questions.context: 教師備註：：這裡的 let 可作過去時，與原形同形。
questions.explanation: 正確；let + 人 + see。

questions.word: 關係子句 that + 動詞
questions.meaning: that 引出修飾前面名詞的關係子句。
questions.usage: 要進一步說明「哪一些」人或物。
questions.prompt: 你想談那些不是很乾淨的桌子。
options: The tables that were not very clean needed help.
The tables that were not very clean needed helped.
The tables that not very clean needed help.
The tables were that not very clean needed help.
optionExplanations: 正確；that were ... 修飾 tables。
needed 後接原形 help，不是 helped。
that 後少了 were。
that 子句的位置錯誤。
questions.cue: 「That weren't all that pretty」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：此來源的 that 接上一行 parts of me。
questions.explanation: 正確；that were ... 修飾 tables。

questions.meaning: 在否定環境中 all that + 形容詞意為「那麼、特別」。
questions.usage: 婉轉說某事沒有想像中那麼好。
questions.prompt: 餐館的海報很好看，實際餐點卻沒那麼美味。
options: The soup was not all that taste.
The soup was all that not good.
The soup not was all that good.
The soup was not all that good.
optionExplanations: taste 不是此處所需的形容詞。
not 應放在 all that 前。
否定語序不對。
正確；not all that good 表示並沒有很好。
questions.cue: 「all that pretty」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：同一來源可含不同語法焦點，但本題專教程度修飾。
questions.explanation: 正確；not all that good 表示並沒有很好。

questions.meaning: with every + 單數名詞，表示每一次伴隨的情況。
questions.usage: 描述每次某件事發生，便有同樣影響。
questions.prompt: 每次敲鼓，舞者都向前一步。
options: With every beat the dancers moving.
With every beats, the dancers move.
With every beat, the dancers move forward.
With every beat, the dancers moves forward.
optionExplanations: 主句少了完整動詞。
every 後用單數 beat。
正確；with every + 單數名詞。
複數主詞 dancers 接 move。
questions.cue: 「with every touch」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：不額外抽出未出現的 whenever 模式。
questions.explanation: 正確；with every + 單數名詞。

questions.meaning: have/has been + V-ing 表示從之前延續到現在的行為。
questions.usage: 談最近一直發生的事情。
questions.prompt: 花藝師這週一直在準備花展。
options: The florist has been preparing flowers all week.
The florist has been prepare flowers all week.
The florist have been preparing flowers all week.
The florist has prepare flowers all week.
optionExplanations: 正確；has been preparing。
been 後需 V-ing。
單數主詞需 has。
has 後不能接原形 prepare。
questions.cue: 「you've been talking」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：與單純現在進行式不同。
questions.explanation: 正確；has been preparing。

questions.meaning: 名詞後接主詞 + 動詞，受詞位置的關係代名詞可省略。
questions.usage: 指出具體是哪一類東西。
questions.prompt: 哪句最自然地說「我昨天拍的照片」？
options: These are the photos who I took yesterday.
These are photos I yesterday took them.
These are the photos I took yesterday.
These are the photos I took them yesterday.
optionExplanations: who 一般指人，不能用來修飾 photos。
語序不自然且重複受詞。
正確；photos 後省略受詞關係代名詞。
多加 them，造成重複受詞。
questions.cue: 「Things you never say to me」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：不將補出的 that 當來源中的字。
questions.explanation: 正確；photos 後省略受詞關係代名詞。

questions.meaning: tell + 人 + that 子句，傳達一個完整訊息。
questions.usage: 要別人清楚說明實情。
questions.prompt: 場館管理員請工作人員告訴他門已經關了。
options: Tell me that the door is closed.
Tell that me the door is closed.
Tell to me that the door is closed.
Tell me the door closed is that.
optionExplanations: 正確；tell + me + that 子句。
tell 後的 me 應緊跟其後。
此處 tell me 不加 to。
子句字序錯誤。
questions.cue: 「Tell me that you've had enough」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：來源中的 had enough 另有獨立語義焦點。
questions.explanation: 正確；tell + me + that 子句。

questions.meaning: 現在完成式 have had enough，表示已經受夠了。
questions.usage: 遇到長時間不舒服、厭煩的情況。
questions.prompt: 隔壁的鑽孔聲持續幾小時，住戶受夠了。
options: I have had enough of the noise.
I had have enough of the noise.
I have had enough to the noise.
I have enough had of the noise.
optionExplanations: 正確；have had enough of。
完成式次序錯。
應是 enough of + 名詞。
完成式次序錯。
questions.cue: 「you've had enough」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：of our love 在下一行；理解時應連讀。
questions.explanation: 正確；have had enough of。

questions.meaning: just 可柔化或加強要求，意思近「只要／就」。
questions.usage: 希望對方先做一件簡單的事。
questions.prompt: 朋友希望你先看一眼表演時間。
options: Just to check the show time.
optionExplanations: 此處不是完整命令句。
V-ing 不適合作此命令句核心。
正確；just + 命令句原形。
命令句用原形 check。
questions.cue: 「Just give me a reason」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：不要把 just 當成額外的助動詞。
questions.explanation: 正確；just + 命令句原形。

questions.word: give + 間接受詞 + 直接受詞
questions.meaning: give + 人 + 物，先指出接收者，再說給甚麼。
questions.usage: 送出資訊、物品或理由。
questions.prompt: 木工把一把工具給助手。
options: The carpenter gave his helper a tool.
The carpenter gave to his helper a tool him.
The carpenter gave a tool his helper.
The carpenter gave his helper to a tool.
optionExplanations: 正確；gave + 人 + 物。
多出 him 且結構錯。
此形式少了介系詞 to，順序不對。
helper 後不接 to a tool。
questions.cue: 「give me a reason」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：與 just 的話語語氣不同，這是雙受詞結構。
questions.explanation: 正確；gave + 人 + 物。

questions.meaning: 少量事物也足以符合需要；bit 是單數。
questions.usage: 強調不必很多也夠。
questions.prompt: 花盆只需一點陽光就夠了。
options: A little bits is enough for the plant.
A little bit are enough for the plant.
A little bit is enough for this small plant.
A little bit be enough for the plant.
optionExplanations: a little bits 數量形式錯。
bit 是單數，要用 is。
正確；a little bit is enough。
缺少正確 be 動詞。
questions.cue: 「a little bit's enough」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：來源 bit's = bit is。
questions.explanation: 正確；a little bit is enough。

questions.word: be not + 過去分詞／狀態形容詞
questions.meaning: broken、bent 在此描述狀態，與 be 連用，並非必須指被動事件。
questions.usage: 對比受損程度或狀態。
questions.prompt: 椅子只是彎了，沒有斷掉。
options: The chair not is broken, just bent.
The chair is not break, just bend.
The chair does not broken, only bent.
The chair is not broken, just bent.
optionExplanations: 否定順序錯。
break、bend 需用分詞／形容詞形式。
描述狀態應用 be + broken。
正確；is not broken, just bent。
questions.cue: 「We're not broken just bent」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：不把歌詞說成一般事件被動語態的唯一例證。
questions.explanation: 正確；is not broken, just bent。

questions.meaning: learn to + 動詞原形，表示學會做某事。
questions.usage: 談技能、態度與新習慣的學習。
questions.prompt: 成年初學者正學習游泳。
options: They learn to swim after work.
They learn to swimming after work.
They learn swimming to after work.
They learn to swims after work.
optionExplanations: 正確；learn to swim。
to 後需原形 swim。
to 的位置錯。
swims 不是原形。
questions.cue: 「learn to love again」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：again 是重複副詞，原歌與 learn to 搭配。
questions.explanation: 正確；learn to swim。

questions.meaning: has been written 是現在完成被動式，強調結果至今相關。
questions.usage: 事情此前已完成，而痕跡現在仍在。
questions.prompt: 展覽標題早已寫在牆上。
options: The title is been written on the wall.
The title has been written on the wall.
The title has been wrote on the wall.
The title has written on the wall.
optionExplanations: is been 不能構成完成被動式。
正確；has been written。
write 的過去分詞是 written。
少了 been，不能表達此被動式。
questions.cue: 「It's been written」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：歌詞中的 It's = It has，由 been written 判斷。
questions.explanation: 正確；has been written。

questions.word: 現在進行式：此刻或目前
questions.meaning: be + V-ing 描述正在發生的事。
questions.usage: 指眼前或近期正在發生的事件。
options: Workers are repair the bridge now.
Workers are repairing the bridge now.
Workers is repairing the bridge now.
optionExplanations: 缺少 be 動詞，且 bridge 不能直接當修理者。
are 後需 repairing。
正確；are repairing。
複數 Workers 用 are。
questions.cue: 「this is happenin'」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：來源 happenin' 為非正式省略 g 拼法。
questions.explanation: 正確；are repairing。

questions.meaning: used to + 原形動詞描述過去習慣、現在可能已不同。
questions.usage: 回憶以前常做的事。
questions.prompt: 爺爺以前每天在院子種花。
options: My grandpa used to planted flowers.
My grandpa used to planting flowers.
My grandpa use to plant flowers.
My grandpa used to plant flowers.
optionExplanations: to 後用 plant。
used to 後接原形。
過去習慣通常用 used to。
正確；used to plant。
questions.cue: 「You used to lie so close to me」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：lie 是「躺」，不是 lay（放置）。
questions.explanation: 正確；used to plant。

questions.word: there is nothing more than + 名詞
questions.meaning: 指出除了某物以外別無其他。
questions.usage: 描述某處所剩無幾的東西。
questions.prompt: 旅行箱裡只剩下一張紙。
options: There is nothing more than a sheet of paper in the bag.
There is no more than papers a bag.
There is nothing more as a sheet of paper.
There are nothing more than a paper.
optionExplanations: 正確；there is nothing more than ...。
語序不合句意。
固定比較用 than，不用 as。
nothing 作單數，且 a paper 用法不當。
questions.cue: 「There's nothing more than empty sheets」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：原歌後面 between our love 具比喻性，不應說是普通空間片語。
questions.explanation: 正確；there is nothing more than ...。

questions.meaning: will 用於未來行動、當下承諾。
questions.usage: 答應稍後解決問題。
questions.prompt: 燈泡壞了，哥哥主動答應修好。
options: I will fixing the lamp tomorrow.
I wills fix the lamp tomorrow.
I will fixed the lamp tomorrow.
I will fix the lamp tomorrow.
optionExplanations: will 後不接 fixing。
will 不依主詞加 s。
will 後接原形 fix。
正確；will fix。
questions.cue: 「I'll fix it for us」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 3 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：不同於 can 能力表達。
questions.explanation: 正確；will fix。

questions.meaning: collect dust 表積灰塵或被閒置；正在持續時用 be + collecting。
questions.usage: 某件物品長久沒有使用。
questions.prompt: 舞台角落的舊鼓很久沒有用。
options: The old drum is collect dust backstage.
The old drum is collecting dust backstage.
The old drum is collecting to dust backstage.
The old drum collecting dust backstage.
optionExplanations: is 後需 collecting。
正確；is collecting dust。
collect dust 不加 to。
缺少 is。
questions.cue: 「We're collecting dust」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 3 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：本項聚焦片語與進行式的結合，不重複基礎進行式題。
questions.explanation: 正確；is collecting dust。

questions.meaning: hold something in 表示將感受忍住不表露。
questions.usage: 想說有人壓抑笑、眼淚或情緒。
questions.prompt: 你想忍住笑，避免打斷魔術師。
options: I held in it a laugh during the show.
I held my laughter in during the show.
I hold in to laugh during the show.
I held my laughter into during the show.
optionExplanations: 代名詞 it 通常置於 hold 和 in 中間。
正確；held my laughter in。
不合此片語結構。
應使用 in 而非 into。
questions.cue: 「You're holding it in」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 3 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：來源 it 指語境中的感受，並未明說具體是哪種情緒。
questions.explanation: 正確；held my laughter in。

questions.meaning: 表示程度一樣；搭配否定是「沒看起來那麼……」。
questions.usage: 比較事情的實際情況與表面印象。
questions.prompt: 箱子看起來很重，抬起來卻不那麼重。
options: The box was not as heavy than it looked.
The box was not as heavy it looked.
The box was not so heavy that it looked.
The box was not as heavy as it looked.
optionExplanations: as...as 不能把第二個 as 換成 than。
少了第二個 as。
that 不符合此比較形式。
正確；not as heavy as it looked。
questions.cue: 「as bad as it seems」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 3 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：原歌前置 No 是話語標記，後接 nothing；不將兩者誤解為可任意套用的雙重否定。
questions.explanation: 正確；not as heavy as it looked。

questions.word: as + it seems 的表面印象
questions.meaning: seem 表示某事給人的印象，不保證事情真的如此。
questions.usage: 對照外表與真相。
questions.prompt: 小劇院外觀看起來很小。
options: The hall seem small from outside.
The hall seems small from outside.
The hall seeming small from outside.
The hall seems to small from outside.
optionExplanations: 單數 hall 應用 seems。
正確；seems 後接形容詞 small。
缺少 be 動詞。
seems 後不能直接用 to + 形容詞。
questions.cue: 「it seems」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 3 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：本項著重 seem 感官／判斷動詞，不重複程度比較。
questions.explanation: 正確；seems 後接形容詞 small。

questions.meaning: come clean 是坦白實情的固定片語。
questions.usage: 曾隱瞞錯誤，現在願意誠實說出。
questions.prompt: 志工打破展示品，後來決定坦白。
options: She came clean her room before lunch.
She came clean to the museum by train.
She came clean about the broken vase.
She came clean the glass with water.
optionExplanations: 清理房間應說 cleaned her room。
前往某地應說 went to。
正確；came clean about + 事情。
字面「洗乾淨」不等於坦白，且缺少適當動詞。
questions.cue: 「We'll come clean」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 3 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：come clean 不是 come + 形容詞「變乾淨」的普通句型。
questions.explanation: 正確；came clean about + 事情。

questions.word: can + 原形動詞：可能與能力
questions.meaning: can + 原形動詞表示可以／有能力做某事。
questions.usage: 談努力後仍有可能做到的事。
questions.prompt: 園丁相信植物仍能恢復。
options: The plant can to grow again.
optionExplanations: can 後用原形 grow。
can 不加 s。
正確；can grow again。
can 後不加 to。
questions.cue: 「we can learn to love again」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：和 learn to 的結構不同，是上層情態動詞。
questions.explanation: 正確；can grow again。

questions.word: be + 副詞 + 過去分詞
questions.meaning: still 放在 be 與過去分詞之間，表示狀態仍持續。
questions.usage: 說某事至今仍留有記錄。
questions.prompt: 客人的姓名仍寫在名單上。
options: Her name still is write on the list.
Her name is still writing on the list.
Her name is write still on the list.
Her name is still written on the list.
optionExplanations: written 才是過去分詞，語序也不自然。
writing 變成進行狀態，意思不同。
write 不是過去分詞，still 位置不當。
正確；is still written。
questions.cue: 「You're still written」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 3 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：與已出現的 has been written 不同：本句的 You're = You are。
questions.explanation: 正確；is still written。

questions.meaning: 用 not A, just B 修正對方過度嚴重的描述。
questions.usage: 描述問題有存在但沒那麼嚴重。
questions.prompt: 道具沒有碎掉，只是髒了。
options: The model is not broken, only it dirty.
The model is not broken, just dirty.
The model is no broken, just dirty.
The model not broken, just dirty.
optionExplanations: 後半句缺少 is 且結構不對等。
正確；not A, just B 形成對比。
形容詞前要 not，不用 no。
缺少 is。
questions.cue: 「not broken just bent」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：這是修辭焦點，與過去分詞的形式分析不同。
questions.explanation: 正確；not A, just B 形成對比。

questions.meaning: thought that + 子句表達過去的想法。
questions.usage: 回顧自己之前以為的情況。
questions.prompt: 導覽員以為博物館今天開放。
options: I thought that the museum was open today.
I thought that the museum were open today.
I thought that the museum open today.
I thought that was the museum open today.
optionExplanations: 正確；that + 主詞 + was open。
單數 museum 應用 was。
子句缺少 was。
把陳述子句倒裝成問句。
questions.cue: 「I thought that we were fine」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁
questions.context: 教師備註：：與 know that 的當下確信不同。
questions.explanation: 正確；that + 主詞 + was open。

questions.word: 間接疑問句：where + 陳述語序
questions.meaning: 間接問題維持陳述句語序，通常接在 understand 等動詞後。
questions.usage: 想知道一個情況的來源。
questions.prompt: 你不知道劇院裡的聲音從哪裡來。
options: I do not know where is the sound coming from.
I do not know where does the sound come from.
I do not know where from the sound is coming.
I do not know where the sound is coming from.
optionExplanations: 間接問句不倒裝 is。
間接問句不加疑問助動詞 does。
from 的位置錯誤。
正確；where + the sound + is coming。
questions.cue: 「Where all of this is coming from」｜來源：PDF 英文歌詞第 2 頁

pattern.text: all of this is coming from

questions.context: 教師備註：：須連同上一行 I do not understand 一起理解。
questions.explanation: 正確；where + the sound + is coming。

advanced.title: 進階字彙
advanced.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 小偷、竊賊（複數 thieves）
questions.usage: 指偷取別人財物的人；歌詞把「偷心」的人比喻成竊賊。
options: A thief took her bag while she was away.
We called the nurse a thief because she helped us.
The thief taught us a new song at school.
The thief repaired my broken bike for free.
optionExplanations: 正確：小偷趁她不在時拿走包包。
護理師提供幫助不是竊賊的特徵。
教唱歌不是偷取財物，情境不支持 thief。
修理腳踏車並不構成偷竊，缺乏符合詞義的證據。
questions.explanation: 正確：小偷趁她不在時拿走包包。

questions.word: stole my heart / steal someone’s heart
questions.meaning: 贏得某人的芳心、使某人愛上自己
questions.usage: 浪漫比喻；不是真的偷走心臟。使用 steal + 人的 + heart。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「stole my heart / steal someone’s heart」？
options: The doctor stole my heart during the operation.
He stole my heart to check my blood pressure.
Her kind smile stole my heart on our first date.
The thief stole my heart from the hospital fridge.
optionExplanations: 醫師動手術不是浪漫的「贏得芳心」；若真指手術也不能這樣含糊表達。
量血壓不是贏得芳心；此處把心當器官。
正確：初次約會時，她的笑容深深打動我。
把心臟當作冰箱物品，與浪漫比喻不符。
questions.explanation: 正確：初次約會時，她的笑容深深打動我。

questions.meaning: 受害者；遭受傷害或不公平對待的人
questions.usage: 談犯罪、事故、欺騙的受害者；歌詞中的 willing victim 是矛盾式的浪漫比喻。
options: The winner was a victim because she got first place.
Our cook was a victim because the soup was tasty.
The driver was a victim because his car was blue.
The victim lost her money in the online trick.
optionExplanations: 得第一名不表示遭到傷害，不能由此稱受害者。
食物好吃並不構成受害情境。
車子顏色不能證明某人是受害者。
正確：她在網路詐騙中損失金錢。
questions.explanation: 正確：她在網路詐騙中損失金錢。

questions.meaning: 說夢話
questions.usage: 指人在睡著時不自覺說話；不是睡前聊天。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「talk in one’s sleep」？
options: My roommate talks in her sleep, but remembers nothing.
I talked in my sleep before I went to bed.
We talked in our sleep over lunch at noon.
He talked in his sleep during a video call at work.
optionExplanations: 正確：室友睡著時說夢話，醒來不記得。
還沒上床睡覺時說話，不是睡夢中說話。
中午吃飯時聊天不等於睡著說夢話。
工作視訊通話時講話不代表在睡夢中。
questions.explanation: 正確：室友睡著時說夢話，醒來不記得。

questions.meaning: 命中注定的、彷彿由命運安排
questions.usage: 偏詩意的表達，常見於 it is written in the stars；不表示文字真的寫在星球上。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「in the stars」？
options: Our flight time is in the stars on the ticket.
Her name was in the stars on the class list.
They felt their meeting was written in the stars.
The library put its books in the stars last week.
optionExplanations: 機票上標示時間不會用 in the stars 表示。
班級名單上的名字不是命運安排的詩意用法。
正確：兩人覺得相遇彷彿命中注定。
書本存放地點並不是星星；搭配不自然。
questions.explanation: 正確：兩人覺得相遇彷彿命中注定。

questions.meaning: 淚管、淚液排出的通道
questions.usage: 解剖名詞；淚液經淚點進入淚管等排出路徑。歌詞將其與 rust 並列，形成詩意意象。
options: My tear ducts help me hear quiet sounds at night.
The nurse checked his tear ducts because tears could not drain.
Tear ducts carry food from my mouth to my stomach.
Our tear ducts help us smell the fresh flowers.
optionExplanations: 聽力由耳朵相關構造負責，不是淚管。
正確：淚液排出不順，護理師檢查淚管。
從嘴巴輸送食物的不是淚管。
嗅覺由鼻腔相關構造負責，不是淚管。
questions.explanation: 正確：淚液排出不順，護理師檢查淚管。

questions.meaning: 鐵鏽；（金屬）生鏽
questions.usage: 談鐵或鋼暴露於水分、空氣後生鏽；歌詞把鏽蝕當成關係變舊的意象。
options: Her glass cup got rust after she washed it.
The old gate has rust after years of rain.
The wooden chair had rust because it was painted red.
The paper map had rust from being folded.
optionExplanations: 一般玻璃杯不會本身生鐵鏽。
正確：舊鐵門受多年雨水影響而生鏽。
木椅本身不會像鐵器那樣生鐵鏽。
紙張摺疊可能破損，卻不會生鐵鏽。
questions.explanation: 正確：舊鐵門受多年雨水影響而生鏽。

questions.word: pouring a drink / pour a drink
questions.meaning: 倒飲料；把液體倒入杯中
questions.usage: pour + 飲料，表示把液體倒出；歌詞中的 drink 依派對語境可能指酒。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「pouring a drink / pour a drink」？
options: He poured a drink into a glass for his guest.
The waiter poured a drink by closing the door.
She poured a drink by turning on the music.
I poured a drink by putting away my empty cup.
optionExplanations: 正確：他把飲料倒進杯子招待客人。
關門不是把液體倒出。
播放音樂不等於倒飲料。
收起空杯並不是倒飲料。
questions.explanation: 正確：他把飲料倒進杯子招待客人。

questions.meaning: 我的不同面向；自己內在的一部分
questions.usage: 歌詞指個性、情緒與不完美之處；不是字面上的身體零件。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「parts of me」？
options: My lunch has parts of me because it tastes sweet.
The teacher counted parts of me on the whiteboard.
The mechanic replaced the parts of me in my car.
I showed her the shy parts of me through my writing.
optionExplanations: 食物味道不能證明含有「我的內在面向」。
老師在白板計數並非在描述我的性格面向。
汽車零件應說 parts of my car，不能說 parts of me。
正確：透過寫作展露自己害羞的一面。
questions.explanation: 正確：透過寫作展露自己害羞的一面。
